sourceText:
Crockpot Meal
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 10:17pm

Ingredients




1 pound Lean ground beef
pound Bacon
1 cup Chopped onion
2 cans (15-oz) pork & beans, not drained
1 can (15-oz) kidney beans, drained
1 can Lima beans, drained
1 cup Catsup
cup Brown sugar
1 teaspoon Liquid Smoke
3 tablespoons White vinegar
1 teaspoon Salt
1 teaspoon Pepper
1 teaspoon Seasoned salt
Garlic powder

Preparation

1 Brown meat in skillet & drain off fat. Fry bacon. Saute onion in bacon drippings & drain off excess grease. Break up bacon in small pieces. Add everything to a heated crockpot & cook on low setting 4-6 hours. Stir occasionally if possible. (Delicious. Guys love it on a cold winter day better than chili.)
